the Five Explicits fields required of every project

frozen.title: The evidence-package format
surface: the strict canonical JSON round trip of an EvidencePackage
the Merkle root construction over claims and provenance
claim evidence colours and the conservative composition rule
the optional format-9 source-manifest identity citation carried by Provenance::with_source_manifest_identity

frozen.deprecation_horizon: none: a superseded package format is refused immediately and by name, never silently reinterpreted

frozen.title: The standalone checker protocol

frozen.deprecation_horizon: none: a mismatched protocol is refused, never negotiated down

frozen.major_bump: any change to the canonical bytes, Context binding, extension or hypothesis-source semantics, claim-policy graph, no-claim set, owner matrix, or identity domain
frozen.deprecation_horizon: not yet applicable: v1 has no predecessor and every other version refuses

frozen.deprecation_horizon: none: v1 has no predecessor and every other version refuses rather than reinterpreting authority routing

frozen.title: The nine-kind Euler-disc claim and minimum-evidence policy

frozen.major_bump: any semantic policy change, including a new claim kind or an authority widening
frozen.deprecation_horizon: none: an unknown claim-policy version refuses rather than negotiating down

frozen.title: The Euler-disc structural checker and local evidence-reference assessment protocol
surface: the exact evidence-role source schemas, caller-declared access classes, bindings, and explicitly unre-admitted local candidate dispositions
the separately encoded structural contract-check receipt canonical bytes and identity

frozen.deprecation_horizon: none: v1 has no predecessor; the strict receipt decoder and complete canonical assessment-log reader refuse mismatched versions or malformed fields, while packet/prerequisite/assessment bytes are identity preimages rather than promised public rehydration transports

frozen.title: The scenario IR

typed boundary, load, and quantity records with six-base dimensions

frozen.title: The FSMATPK material pack family

frozen.deprecation_horizon: not yet applicable: the family has never been bumped, so no predecessor exists to support

frozen.deprecation_horizon: every rung from v1 forward stays migratable; dropping a rung requires a decision record
